overview: General info – Applicable to all types of leases (office, retail and or industrial). The lease expiration date is the date till which the term of the lease holds good. Scenarios 1: The Lease expiration date Can be fetched from Commencement Letter stating lease expiration date may be provided as an explicit date part of the lease agreement (either in the summary and or the body of the lease) or Formula based on may be a language Lease Commencement Date (LCD) /or Rent Commencement date (RCD) and the Term Ie. LED = LCD/RCD + term definition Scenarios 2: (Amendment available) – If an amendment is available, then Lease Expiration date to be sourced based on the amendment. Context: Abstraction of the below data fields from the perspective of an Originator or an Underwriter. Does the lease contain a Summary Section Keywords Definition of firm date: Explicit calendar date (e.g., January 1, 2025) Numeric date (01/01/2025) Caution: Ensure there are no strings prior or post the commencement date ie there should be no text or string pre or post the dates. If any sort of text exists like, anticipated to be or est, treat this to be a text and do not stop at this point. If the date is a text extract the descriptive details of the date and then go to QUESTION 4.Caution: Ensure there are no strings prior or post the commencement date ie there should be no text or string pre or post the dates. If any sort of text exists like, anticipated to be or est, treat this to be a text and do not stop at this point. If the date is a text extract the descriptive details of the date and then go to QUESTION 4.
